text:
alice.k: kicking off config-only deploy to adjust per-route shaper and batching. canary at 10% for 15m. TL;DR: reduce max_concurrent per-route to 60, batch_window to 6ms for small gen routes.

deploy-bot: config-deploy started by alice.k · canary=10% · change_id=cfg-2026-11-05-002

sam.engineering: noted. which routes are we targeting? web-gen and embed-preview?

alice.k: yes — routes = ["/v1/generate", "/v1/embed/preview"]. also lower route timeout from 7s -> 5s for generate to fail fast on overloaded backends.

priya.r: quick question — dropping timeout can increase client retries; are we applying client-side retry guidance in release notes?

alice.k: good call. adding note: recommend idempotent POST with retry-after logic. I'll include in the change description.

mateo.sre: watching infra metrics. will check latency p50/p95 during canary. if error rate > 1.5% for 5m, we abort and rollback.

sam.engineering: config snippet pasted here:
```
routes:
  - name: generate
    max_concurrent: 60
    batch_window_ms: 6
    timeout_ms: 5000
  - name: embed-preview
    max_concurrent: 40
    batch_window_ms: 10
    timeout_ms: 8000
fallback_policy: prefer-private-variant
```

deploy-bot: canary rollout at 10% completed -> 2% traffic showing slight p95 increase (200ms) on /v1/generate

mateo.sre: observation — p95 up 200ms but errors stable. continuing to 50% over next 10m.

priya.r: adding note to release: "Config-only: tightened timeouts and reshaped batching for gen/embed routes. See #cfg-2026-11-05-002 for peeking ops runbook."

sam.engineering: if error rate spikes we revert to previous config using cfg-2026-10-28 baseline. Everyone ok with proceed to 50%?

alice.k: proceed.

deploy-bot: rollout updated -> canary 50% · targeting full rollout at 100% in 20m if no regressions.

mateo.sre: no alert triggers so far. keeping watch.

priya.r: lgtm, will add the retry guidance blurb to the release notes.

(19m later)

deploy-bot: rollout complete -> 100% · finished at 1798804450 · change_id=cfg-2026-11-05-002

alice.k: thanks team. follow-up: watch client retry patterns for next 24h and re-evaluate batch_window if gen tokens cost increases.

sam.engineering: filing a short post-deploy check item in the release tracker.
